riscos: The screen loses roughly 70% of its content. Measured honestly: the radar goes from 29 cards to 3, and the detail page loses the evidence bars, the competitor panel, the action map, the executive timeline, the field inbox, the adjacency map shading, the latin name, the origin tile and the label-timing line. What remains — title, what is happening with a named document and date, why it matters, what we know, what we do not know, interpretations, sources — is genuinely strong content, but it is one column where there were three. The client must be told BEFORE the edit, not after, and §3 forbids redesigning the screen to fill the hole.

The three real records are written in PORTUGUESE, and §11 makes Italian the default language. TITLE, CROP, ISSUE, CURRENT_EVIDENCE, WHAT_WE_KNOW, WHAT_WE_DO_NOT_KNOW and INTERPRETATIONS are all pt-BR ('Videira', 'Milho grao', 'a obrigacao de tratar o vetor e norma, nao recomendacao'). The regulatory quotes inside them are Italian. This is not a translation the engineer may perform — translating a source record is exactly the fact-mutation the product law forbids, and product/company/Latin names must not be touched at all. Either upstream reissues the records in Italian, or the portal ships with visibly Portuguese body text on its three real cards. Flag to the data owner before STEP 2.

ISSUE_TYPE on opp 003 is the literal string 'NAO SEI' ('I do not know'). The same literal appears across the real data: VOICES.REGION is 'NAO SEI' 17/17, NEWS.REGION 8/8, FUTURE_SIGNALS.REGION 2/3. Any code path that renders a raw field will print 'NAO SEI' to an Italian user. Every new binding needs an explicit guard mapping it to t.notKnown.

Four incompatible crop vocabularies coexist in the real data and the synonym table is load-bearing. Measured: OPPORTUNITIES.CROP is Portuguese; CANONICAL.CROP_NAME and D.CASES.crop are English; COMP_ACTIVITIES.crops is Latin/Italian ('Vitis vinifera' 42, 'Zea mays' 67, 'colture' 59, 'cereali' 24); VOICES.CROP and SCIENCE.CROP are SCREAMING_SNAKE ('VINE' 45, 'MAIZE' 8, 'DURUM_WHEAT' 40). If the table is wrong the detail page will show competitor and science cross-links belonging to the wrong crop — a silent wrong answer, worse than an empty panel. Build it as one reviewed literal and default to empty, never to a fuzzy match.

There is a FIFTH id space for cases. VOICES.CASE_ID measures as IT-VINE-FLAVESCENCE (8 voices), IT-MAIZE-WEED (8) and IT-DURUM_WHEAT-FUSARIUM (1). Only the first corresponds to a real opportunity. So if the detail page adds a field-voices panel, opp 001 gets 8 voices and opp 002 and 003 get zero — and the 8 MAIZE voices are about WEEDS, not the piralide that opp 002 is about. Do not join maize to maize.

All 29 canonical windows measure PROVENANCE = 'EXPECTED_NORM', SOURCE_IDS = [] and PRODUCT_MATCHES = []. They are audited agronomic norms, not observations, and they carry no traceable source. Treating them as the radar's real feed instead of the 3 opportunities would produce a denser and more comfortable screen that still cannot answer 'who published this'. That temptation will present itself around STEP 9 when the KPI numbers look thin. Windows already have their own screen; leave them there.

MARKET_CONTEXT, COMPETITOR_CONTEXT and FIELD_VOICES are present on 3/3 records but their values are folder paths ('ver 01-DESIGN-READY/MARKET-PULSE/'). They look like fields and are not data. Any engineer scanning the schema will try to render them. They must be dropped in the mapper, not passed through.

WHAT_IS_HAPPENING.SOURCE_ID is present 3/3 and resolvable 0/3 ('IT-T3-002', 'IT-T3-006 (ERSA FVG)', 'IT-T4-001' against an IG.SOURCES id set that only contains IT-SRC-* ids). Rendering it as a clickable source would produce dead links on every real card. Text only.
CURRENT_EVIDENCE and WHAT_WE_KNOW are byte-identical on all 3 records. Rendering both fills two panels with the same list and manufactures an appearance of corroboration. Render one.

decorate() at portale.html:2425 does `Object.assign(c, ...)` — it mutates its input. Because it is called per render (see the comment at 2516) it currently writes presentation labels back into the demo records. Reusing that pattern on AM.collections.opportunities.records would corrupt the shared model across views. decorateOpportunity must return a new object; this is easy to miss when copying the existing method.

Cross-domain edits. Lines 2580, 2665, 2860-2863, 2946 and 3169 sit in the Competitor, Crop Windows and Market domains and are owned by other specs. Their D.CASES reads must be removed for this domain to be clean, so the serial engineer has to sequence these with the other domain owners or the same lines will be edited twice.

state.showScenarios already exists and is already false by default, but grep it before wiring: if another screen already uses it for a different purpose, the new radar toggle would silently change that screen too.
perguntas_abertas: Will upstream reissue the 3 OPPORTUNITIES records in Italian, or does the portal ship with Portuguese body text on its three real cards? This blocks nothing technically but it is the single most visible quality issue after the count drop, and it is not the engineer's call to translate.

All three records carry the identical SOURCE_IDS triple [IT-SRC-MINISTERO, IT-SRC-PIEMONTE, IT-SRC-OPENALEX], so the 'sources behind this case' panel shows the same 3 rows on every case. Is that the real provenance, or is it a placeholder that upstream intends to make per-record? If placeholder, the panel should show the WHAT_IS_HAPPENING.DOCUMENT string alone until it is fixed.

Opp 003 ('Portfolio ADAMA Italia — authorisation expiry calendar') is not a crop x issue case at all: no crop, no region beyond 'Italia (nacional)', no agronomic window, ISSUE_TYPE 'NAO SEI'. Should it appear on the crop-oriented Opportunity Radar, or does it belong on the Portfolio screen? Rendering it as a radar card forces every crop/region/window binding to degrade at once.

Opp 002's CURRENT_EVIDENCE states in prose that six ADAMA products name Piralide/Diabrotica on the maize label, while its ADAMA_PRODUCTS array is empty. Is the array simply unfilled upstream? Confirm before shipping a card that says LABEL_CHECK_NEEDED next to a sentence claiming six labelled products.

Should the radar keep the word 'opportunity' at all? FORBIDDEN_LABEL is present 3/3 and reads 'nao chamar de "oportunidade Italia" nem de "oportunidade comercial"', and CASE_LABEL says 'CONVERGENCIA QUE MERECE INVESTIGACAO'. That affects the nav item, the i18n keys, the KPI tile and the page title — a naming decision, not an engineering one.

Is a canonical window allowed to be bound to a real opportunity by content match (crop + region + issue), given that LEGACY_CASE_ID does not connect the two id spaces? A content match is a judgement, and §7 says presentation may not invent an agronomic state. Recommendation: bind only opp 001 -> IT-WIN-0001 if a human confirms it, and leave the other two unbound.

Does the '29 canonical windows' number get to keep the word 'cases' anywhere in the UI, or must every occurrence be relabelled? The region map, the KPI status tiles and the windows nav badge all currently count windows while saying or implying cases.

FERRAMENTAS.resumo: Today the Market Pulse screen is driven end-to-end by window.ITALY_MARKET (italy-market-pulse.js, 596 lines), which is NOT ingested data: it is a hand-authored editorial fixture. It carries no record id, no SOURCE_ID and no PROVENANCE on any of its 8 crop objects, and it attributes its numbers to ISMEA, CUN Grano Duro, BMTI/Unioncamere, ICQRF, Agrofarma-Federchimica, Baltic Exchange, JRC MARS and Veneto Agricoltura — measured: NONE of those appear in IG.SOURCES (31 registered sources), and 20 of its 23 chart values do not exist anywhere in the 77 real market observations (the 3 that coincide numerically — 245, 4.55, 250 — share no id and sit on unrelated products). From that fixture the screen renders a market temperature verdict (PRESSURED / BALANCED / MIXED SIGNALS), a Sintonia "reading", drivers, a PAST-TODAY-OUTLOOK trajectory, a 3-6 month outlook, ISMEA farmer confidence (-1.4), a Baltic Dry input-cost card, production/stocks/trade, per-piazza tables, "what changed", commentary, and an industry tab of Agrofarma sector figures. The only real backing is APP.collections.marketObservations: 77 EU Commission Agri-food Data Portal weekly price rows (IT-SRC-AGRIFOOD, GEOGRAPHY uniformly "IT — praca nomeada"), covering Wheat 13, Maize 11, Durum 8, Barley 8, Olive 36, Grapevine 1 — and ZERO for Tomato, Sugar Beet and Apple, which are three of the eight crop tabs. prova.snippet: "summary": "Today the Market Pulse screen is driven end-to-end by window.ITALY_MARKET (italy-market-pulse.js, 596 lines), which is NOT ingested data:

riscos: The screen shrinks hard. Of roughly 14 rendered components on the crop tab, 9 disappear outright and 2 more lose their headline number. Rule 3 says a smaller truthful screen wins and rule 12 says do not redesign, so the engineer must resist the instinct to backfill the empty grid space.

Blast radius outside the domain. The temperature verdict is read on five other screens (Radar 679, Crop Windows 732/2762, Competitor Watch 1693, Science 2132, Opportunity case 329-336). Removing it silently changes four other people's screens. This must be sequenced with them, not done unilaterally.

The crop mapping is an interpretation, not a field. 'MAI|FEED', 'BLTPAN|PAN', 'DUR|UNKNOWN', 'ORGFOUR|FEED' are EC product codes; nothing upstream says MAI = Maize. It is a safe reading, but it must be declared in the model and visible on screen, and 'DUR|UNKNOWN' carries an explicit unknown quality class that must not be presented as 'durum fino'.

Stale data can be read as current. 12 of 77 rows are on stopped series and their own SERIES_WARNING says the last quotation is NOT a current price — including the only Grapevine row (stopped 2025) and 10 of the 36 olive rows (some last quoted in 2010). If the piazza table renders them plainly, the screen becomes less trustworthy than the fixture it replaced.

Unit and stage collisions. Olive is EUR/100kg, cereals EUR/t, wine Euro/HL; and 40 of 77 rows carry a STAGE (farm gate vs delivery to first customer vs departure from farm) while 37 carry none. Any averaging, ranking or single 'the price' headline across those is methodologically wrong.

One source, one point in time. All 77 rows come from a single provider (EC Agri-food Data Portal) and only the latest observation of each series was ingested, though the source holds 190-364 points per series. The screen must not imply a monitored multi-source market picture.

Numbers the business already saw will change downward. riscos: The screen gets visibly emptier per card while the totals get much bigger (72 -> 503). A reader who only looks at the header will think the product improved; a reader who opens a card will think it regressed. The what-changed strip in particular goes from six confident tiles to essentially one number, because only 1 real record falls inside 7 days.

320 of 503 activities carry no crop and 405 carry no issue. Any widget that groups by crop or issue silently describes a minority of the corpus. Every such panel must publish its own denominator or it will be read as covering everything.

The botanical-to-common-name mapping (Vitis vinifera -> Grapevine) is safe, but the temptation to extend it to the umbrella words (colture, cereali, frutta, ortaggi — 96 activities) is not. 'cereali' is the advertiser's word for an unspecified set; turning it into Wheat would manufacture a fact.

Latin binomials are both crop names and issue names in this corpus, and §11 forbids translating them or truncating at '('. A generic il()/cl() translation pass over the issue filter would corrupt 'Plasmopara viticola' into a Sintonia label.

The 89 ORGANIC_VIDEO records are near-empty (no date, url, text, country, crop, issue). They are real and must be counted, but any list that sorts or filters by time will drop them without saying so. If they are quietly excluded, the company totals on two different panels will disagree (e.g. Syngenta 55 total but 30 in any dated view).

REACHED_IN_ITALY is already correct in the model, but the countrySem string literally says AD_REACHED_COUNTRY != AD_TARGETED_COUNTRY. If the card shows only the flag and drops the caveat, 414 reach observations silently become 414 Italian targeting claims.

IG.COMP_COMPANIES' case-duplicate rows (Bayer/BAYER, Corteva/CORTEVA, Syngenta/SYNGENTA) will double-count company totals if merged naively by exact string. Bayer would show 69 paid on one panel and 86 total on another.

The ADAMA-portfolio side of this domain currently rests entirely on D.CASES[].productLinks, which italy-app-model.js reads at lines 102-105 while never reading ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS. Until step 5 lands, any 'portfolio' wording anywhere in Competitor Watch is demo-backed. This is a cross-domain dependency and the serial engineer should not let a competitor-side edit ship a portfolio claim ahead of it.

The matrix and issue-table markup hard-code their column counts in grid-template-columns strings that appear twice each (header row and data row). Changing one and not the other misaligns the table without any error.
perguntas_abertas: Can upstream supply a synonym table mapping observed advertiser issue terms to canonical ISSUE_NAMEs (Plasmopara viticola -> Downy Mildew, Erysiphe necator -> Powdery Mildew, Zymoseptoria tritici -> Septoria Leaf Blotch, Ceratitis capitata -> Mediterranean Fruit Fly)? Without it the COMPETITOR x ISSUE table can show no portfolio column and the Competitor x Window cross-link resolves for almost nothing (only 30 of 503 activities carry a species-level issue at all).

Should Citrus, Sunflower and Peach appear in the crop density and matrix even though they have no canonical crop window? They are real observed communication (15, 9 and 2 items) but they cannot cross-link to anything. My recommendation is yes, with no window column.

What is the actual collection horizon of the Meta Ad Library pull? The corpus spans 2019-12-05 to 2026-08-26 but per-company first dates differ wildly (BASF 2023-03, FMC 2025-10). If the horizon is per-page rather than global, even the per-company 'first observed' date is not comparable across companies and should be suppressed, not just the lead-time card.

The reference date is 2026-09-02 and the latest observation is 2026-08-26. Is the corpus a one-off load or will it refresh? If it will not refresh, every 'last 30 days' widget on this screen will decay into an empty box and should be reframed as a fixed observation period with explicit start and end dates.

Do the 89 ORGANIC_VIDEO records have any recoverable metadata upstream (title, publish date, url, view count)? IG.CHANNELS carries EXAMPLE_TITLE / EXAMPLE_URL / VIEWS / EXAMPLE_PUBLISHED_AT for 30 channels — if those channels are the same YouTube sources, upstream may be able to attach dates and titles, which would restore the organic half of the feed. Until then the organic records are countable but not displayable as feed items.

Is the CREATIVE GALLERY worth keeping at all with no captured assets, or should the tab be removed so the remaining views (feed, by issue) are not diluted? This is a product decision, not an engineering one.

INSTITUTION on a record is the FIRST author's affiliation, and INSTITUTIONS_TOP on a theme is a works count from a different query. The two panels sit within 20 lines of each other in the markup (2082 and 2175) and mixing their denominators is the easiest mistake available here.

The 'BUSINESS RELEVANCE' column of the records table (SB.RECORD_REL, keyed by demo themeId) can only resolve for the two themes that have records. Keep the column with blanks, or drop the column?

window.ITALY_REAL.SCIENCE (12) and .RESEARCHERS (14) are an earlier hand-curated real fixture with fields IG does not have (kind, what, region, focus, note). riscos: The rebuild's headline number gets WORSE, and that is the point. Window-level portfolio state goes from 10 VERIFIED / 10 LABEL_CHECK_NEEDED / 9 NO_CONFIRMED (measured today, on the 29 opportunity cards) to 12 VERIFIED / 6 LABEL_CHECK_NEEDED / 10 RELATED_PORTFOLIO / 1 NO_CONFIRMED. Verified goes UP (12 vs 10, because 4 audited verified triples were never reachable through the fixture and 2 fixture cards claimed verified without one), but 10 cards drop to the pale-blue RELATED_PORTFOLIO state and one card — Maize · Mycotoxin Risk, IT-WIN-0021 — ends with nothing at all, because no ADAMA fungicide is registered on maize in the 163 rows and 'Mycotoxin Risk' is not a label target. Anyone expecting the screen to get denser will read this as a regression.

The ISSUE_TARGET table is the one hand-authored input in the entire chain and it decides 15 of the 44 evidence-backed rows. If it is written loosely it manufactures matches; if it is written tightly it starves the check-needed class. It must be versioned, attributed, and surfaced per row via mappingRule — otherwise the rebuild replaces a demo fixture with an undocumented human judgement, which is the same defect wearing a better coat.

The RELATED_PORTFOLIO tier is enormous and low-value: 321 rows over 29 windows, with individual windows carrying up to 38 related products (Durum Wheat · Resistant grass weeds). It must be collapsed in the UI (a count plus a 'see all' link), never rendered as a list, or the screens become unreadable and the four-class hierarchy loses meaning.

Tier 1 is empty. The precedence 'HANDOFF V2.1 canonical > verified label verdict' is honoured in code but contributes nothing today: all 29 canonical windows have PRODUCT_MATCHES = []. Do not describe the result as canonical-backed. The strongest real evidence in the system is a 12-verified / 7-not-found audit of 163 labels, dated 2026-09-02, whose own SCOPE_NOTE says it verified the main visible claims and not every connection.

The label audit is small relative to the screens it governs: 19 audited triples against 29 windows and 166 products. Its NOT_FOUND set is 7 triples covering 6 products, and three of those seven are the same claim (Olive Fruit Fly) repeated across three windows — so a single audit row drives three cards to the palest state.

IG.LINKS covers 19 of 163 products. IG.CROPS states the gap explicitly and it is severe: GRAPEVINE has 61 products mentioning the crop and 1 with a use row read; DURUM_WHEAT has 14 and 0. Any check-needed count computed from use rows is a floor, not a measurement of the portfolio.

Deep links break. The competitor-product route ('cproduct') currently addresses 14 demo names; the real set is 36 different names. Old ids, bookmarks and any in-page chip pointing at Belanty/Revysol/Movento will 404 unless a fallback is added.

Four different ADAMA legal entities hold the 163 registrations (ADAMA ITALIA 85, ADAMA AGAN 35, ADAMA MAKHTESHIM 26, ADAMA DEUTSCHLAND 17) while the catalog is the Italian commercial site. Do not merge holder and seller into one 'ADAMA has this product' claim, and keep the two Portafoglio tabs separate — 41 of 44 catalog items match a registration, 3 (BUDGE, EXELGROW, PARLEAF, all SPECIALI) do not and are marked REGULATORY_MATCH_NOT_FOUND upstream.

15 of the 163 registrations have an expiry earlier than the 2026-09-02 reference date and 41 expire before 2027-01-01. Nothing in the current portfolio screens reads expiry. Surfacing a verified label match for an expired authorisation would be a new, avoidable false claim — worth guarding even though it is outside the strict scope of this migration.

D.CASES remains the source of the 29 opportunity objects even after relationships are rebuilt. This spec removes the demo from PRODUCT RELATIONSHIPS only; the opportunity/radar domain owner must handle the rest, and until then the relationship layer will be correct while the card it sits inside is still a scenario.

perguntas_abertas: Is the ISSUE_TARGET mapping (English issue name -> Latin label target) acceptable as a Sintonia-authored artefact, or must it come from upstream? riscos: The archive count on the nav badge goes UP (448 -> 740) while the screen gets visibly thinner: no region column content, no summary paragraph on 323 rows, an empty CONNECTED TO cell on 711 rows. Someone will read that as a regression. It is the opposite — 420 of the old 448 rows were fabricated. Say so before the review, not after.

The 29 WINDOW rows are the ONLY rows with a region and the ONLY rows with a case link, and they are also the least document-like rows in the set: ITALY_CANONICAL.windows[].PROVENANCE is measured 'EXPECTED_NORM', they have no url (29/29 null), and their source reads the literal 'CANONICAL'. Any feature rebuilt on them (a region facet, a per-case evidence list) would be resting an observational claim on an expected agronomic norm. Decide deliberately whether they belong in an archive of captures at all.

The crop filter is a correctness trap. If line 2194 keeps reading the shared {{ cropOptions }} prop, the UI will silently look fine and return at most 5 rows for any crop — a wrong-looking-right failure, the worst kind. This must be caught in the same commit that touches the model, not later.

COMPETITOR rows are 503 of 740 = 68% of the archive. Sorting by date newest-first will make the first pages almost entirely Meta ad records, and the '2026-01-30'-style start dates are ad campaign starts, not publication dates of an observation. Do not let the date column imply 'when this was observed'. Also §9: an archive row must not inherit REACHED_IN_ITALY framing from its geoClass.

archive.source is a display label mixing four vocabularies; if the engineer wires the aSource filter to it instead of the new sourceId, the filter will half-work (it will match 'YOUTUBE' across both VOICE and COMPETITOR rows but split 'University of Verona' from 'IT-SRC-OPENALEX' even though both are OpenAlex science). Join on sourceId only.

The source-detail cross-link depends on a collection owned by another domain. sources.id is demo-polluted for 6 of 31 rows. If the SOURCES owner does not expose a clean sourceId, the 'LATEST CAPTURES · N IN ARCHIVE' block will show 0 for those 6 sources and no one will notice.

18 rows carry the literal string 'NAO SEI' in the date field and 17 of them are VOICES (all 17 IG.VOICES.DATE are 'NAO SEI'). If any code path does new Date(a.date) or a string sort, these will land somewhere arbitrary. Handle dateState explicitly.

Line 3332's unguarded D.ARCHIVE.find(a => a.type === t).typeColor throws the moment a listed type has zero rows. A naive port that swaps D.ARCHIVE for the real collection while keeping the hardcoded 9-type list at line 3331 will crash the Archive view immediately, because 5 of those 9 types have zero real rows.

The title re-composition at line 3326 splits the title on ' · ' and translates each part through T.ARCHTYPES/T.CROPS/T.ISSUES. That was safe on generated titles. On real titles it is not — it would chop publisher headlines and scientific paper titles (e.g. the Xylella fastidiosa paper title) at arbitrary separators and risks truncating a taxonomic name, which §11 forbids. This code must be deleted, not adapted.
perguntas_abertas: Should the 29 WINDOW rows (upstream PROVENANCE 'EXPECTED_NORM', no url, source literal 'CANONICAL') be in the archive at all? Excluding them gives a cleaner 711-row archive of genuinely captured artefacts — but then legacyCaseId and region drop to 0/711 and the 'VIEW IN ARCHIVE →' link from every opportunity detail must be removed rather than degraded.

Two of the 8 NEWS publishers do not resolve to a source-registry id because of name drift ('Agronotizie' vs 'AgroNotizie (Image Line)'; 'Consorzio Fitosanitario di Modena' vs 'Consorzio Fitosanitario Provinciale di Modena'). Should these be normalized upstream in the ingest, or left null? I did not fuzzy-match them — that is a guess, not a derivation.

The crop dimension has 47 distinct values across 5 incompatible vocabularies (canonical English, uppercase codes, Latin binomials, generic Italian words, olive-oil grades). Is normalizing them an upstream ingest job for the next package, or does the portal ship a visibly-grouped dropdown that admits the vocabularies are different?

Should COMPETITOR ad copy (IG.COMP_ACTIVITIES.text, 392/503) be shown verbatim in the drawer? It is public observed communication and §11 says do not translate it — but it is also marketing prose from a competitor rendered inside an ADAMA product, which may need a label rather than a design decision from me.

The 'CONNECTED TO' column loses its meaning once opportunity links cover only 3.9% of rows. Does the product owner want the column repurposed (source / company / kind-appropriate relation) or emptied and the grid narrowed? §12 says preserve component proportions, so I propose repurposing, but this is a product call.

italy-app-model.js does not read window.ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS at all. That is out of my domain, but if a future archive kind carries label-audit records this is where they would land — flagging it so it is not forgotten.
